passives.name: Protecting Partner
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Increases Defense for [Buff_T_4076004_11_2] turn(s) at the start of battle. Greatly reduces all allies' damage taken while the caster is alive. Damage Taken Reduction is removed upon caster's death, but grants Invulnerability and Increased Attack to Dek'Ril for [Buff_T_4076004_11_4] turn(s).

passives.name: Survival Instinct
passives.description: (Passive Effect) At the start of a turn, if the caster is currently inflicted with Burned, becomes Unhealable for [Buff_T_4076003_11_1] turn(s). Increases damage dealt to non-Fire enemies and reduces damage taken from them. Reduces damage dealt to Fire enemies and increases damage taken from them.

buffs.summary: +15% damage to boss if attacker has element advantage
−50% damage to boss if attacker has element disadvantage
